theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiHS_blowUpMap_image_volume
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : Rn N) (r : ℝ) (A : Set (Rn N)), (NullMeasurableSet A volume → NullMeasurableSet (blowUpMap x r '' A) volume) ∧ (0 < r → volume (blowUpMap x r '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ N)⁻¹) * volume A ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, blowUpMap x r '' A ∩ Metric.ball 0 R = blowUpMap x r '' (A ∩ Metric.ball x (r * R)) ∧ Metric.ball 0 R \ blowUpMap x r '' A = blowUpMap x r '' (Metric.ball x (r * R) \ A))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
